description: TypeScript type declarations for a class named BodyReadable, which extends the Readable stream class and provides methods for consuming HTTP response bodies in various formats.

classes.name: BodyReadable
classes.description: A class extending Readable stream that provides methods to consume HTTP response body in different formats such as text, json, blob, bytes, arrayBuffer, and formData.

methods.name: constructor (opts: { constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BodyReadable with options including resume, abort, contentType, contentLength, and highWaterMark.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the response body as a string in a Promise.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the response body as a JavaScript Object in a Promise.

methods.name: blob
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Blob in a Promise.

methods.name: bytes
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Uint8Array in a Promise.

methods.name: arrayBuffer
methods.description: Returns the response body as an ArrayBuffer in a Promise.

methods.name: formData
methods.description: Method not implemented, returns a Promise that rejects with never.

methods.name: bodyUsed
methods.description: A boolean property indicating if the body has been consumed.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Readonly property returning the body as a ReadableStream or undefined.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the response body up to a specified byte limit, optionally cancellable via an AbortSignal.
